instructions: Do not edit the frozen contract after its SHA-256 is recorded here.
Add one decision record per D-01 through D-11 and one authenticated approval entry for every required role.
Each decision record must repeat the exact selectedOption from the frozen contract.
Each approval must be completed within ten minutes of fresh authentication and reference externally verifiable signature evidence.
Typed names and locally invented signature references are not acceptable evidence.
